What is the percentage of water in gypsum, $$ CaCO_3 \cdot 2H_2O $$?

**Molar mass:** H = 1 g; C = 12 g; O = 16 g; Ca = 40 g
explanation_steps:
**Step 1: Calculate the molar mass of the compound ($$ CaCO_3 \cdot 2H_2O $$).**
Note: Although gypsum is chemically $$ CaSO_4 \cdot 2H_2O $$, we must follow the formula provided in the question.
$$ M = (1 \times Ca) + (1 \times C) + (3 \times O) + 2 \times [(2 \times H) + (1 \times O)] $$
$$ M = 40 + 12 + (3 \times 16) + 2 \times [(2 \times 1) + 16] $$
$$ M = 40 + 12 + 48 + 2 \times [18] $$
$$ M = 100 + 36 = 136 \text{ g/mol} $$

**Step 2: Calculate the mass of water in the formula.**
$$ \text{Mass of } H_2O = 2 \times 18 = 36 \text{ g} $$

**Step 3: Calculate the percentage of water.**
$$ \% H_2O = \left( \frac{\text{Mass of water}}{\text{Total Molar Mass}} \right) \times 100 $$
$$ \% H_2O = \left( \frac{36}{136} \right) \times 100 \approx 26.47 \% $$
Rounding to the given options, we get **26.5 %**.
